selection: Each trial uses its already selected maximum-percentage aggregate 30-second window; profile_worst_aggregate_window selects the largest of the three aggregate peaks per profile.
reference: Per-client mean across 3 reference-trial local medians; identical progress matching and eligibility to aggregate analysis.
important: Client decreases here are evaluated at the aggregate peak, not independent per-client maxima. Client percentages do not add; the aggregate percentage is reference-rate-weighted. The two clients are dependent observations in one trial.
